root_cause: 2026-10-24 source-backed blog and company recommendations cite 2020-06-15 government text, discovered 2026-10-20; ranking adds premium and lacked original publication date gate. Source rec with unknown original date can outrank valid topical SEO alternatives.
fix: Use independent original publication date and crawl freshness for sources classified as CURRENT market/search, reject absent/stale original date and safely select the next existing channel recommendation. The content brief now follows chosen source, never the rejected pinned recommendation.
prevention_rule: A crawler observation cannot prove freshness of the underlying information. No fabricated modernized facts. Fallback only within existing channel, preserving editor/identity/publication constraints, and record fallback as existing artifact evidence.
terminal_rule: Required+CodeQL and Supabase Edge exact source readback; then actual approved article/post proof and qualified outcomes, no result guarantee.
